_rule: Each cell's healthy Normal inside a whole blood on arrays, measured on IAM-Atlas v2.1's own 146 blood-cell donor arrays mixed into 200 constructed bloods at the shares of 100 healthy bloods (blood_constructed.py MODE all; the rotation test, met), read by the one command (--full-chain --cell-panel atlas --dev-line-wide): median and standard deviation of each cell's Met-A; k is the prediction interval for one new reading from d donors, t(0.975, d - 1) x sqrt(1 + 1/d) (counted by donors, not bloods). share_min: the lowest share the cell held in those bloods.
